_readme: Unit stat tuning. Edit numbers here; the game picks them up on the next build (npm run dev hot-reloads). Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.

base._comment: Stats every Adventurer (and enemy) has at level 1. Weapons then multiply these (see weapons.json).

growthPerLevel._comment: Added automatically for every level above 1, times the Adventurer's talent growth rate for that stat (see talent).

talent._comment: Every Adventurer has a talent grade (F to S) for each stat that grows with level (growthPerLevel above 0). The grade multiplies that stat's growthPerLevel: C grows at 100%. Grades are rolled when the Adventurer is created. weight sets how common each grade is: a grade's chance is its weight divided by the sum of all weights (so they don't need to add up to anything; 0 = never). Enemies always grow at 100%.

_xpPerLevel: XP needed to go from level L to L + 1: base + step x (L - 1), so 100 at level 1, 125 at level 2, 325 at level 10. Quests give XP as set in guild.json xp; Quick Battle gives exactly one level's worth per win.
_defenseScale: Damage taken is multiplied by defenseScale / (defenseScale + Defense). With 100: 100 Defense = 2x effective health, 200 = 3x. Negative Defense increases damage taken. Resist uses the same scale: the chance to shrug off a debuff is Resist / (defenseScale + Resist), so 50 Resist = 33%, 100 = 50%.
_forestDefense: Extra Defense for a unit standing in forest.

movementCosts._comment: Movement points to enter one tile. Movement 16 = 4 grass tiles. The grass cost also converts Movement into tiles for Movement-scaled skills (Charge).

rangeRounding._comment: Ranges of at least fromRange use rounded distance: a tile is in range if its distance, rounded to the nearest whole tile, is within the range (so range 2 also reaches 2-over-1-up). Smaller ranges (1, 1.5) use exact distance so melee reach stays precise.

map._comment: Battlefield size in tiles. Tiles shrink to fit the screen.

vision._comment: Disabled for now: the whole map is visible. When enabled: a team sees tiles within each unit's Vision range that it has line of sight to; enemies outside that are hidden (fog of war).
